SIGNAL/91 local language model

SIGNAL91.exe starts the server in this folder on 127.0.0.1 when the game opens and
stops it when the game closes. Nothing here connects to the internet.

Default model (MiniCPM5-2B)
  MiniCPM5-2B-Q4_K_M.gguf (1561318368 bytes)
  SHA256: ec2d5801640099e97d8d7e8003ad4d81f336e757811f03a26173dddf386602fd
  Published by OpenBMB:
    https://huggingface.co/openbmb/MiniCPM5-2B-GGUF
  Apache-2.0; see LICENSE-Apache-2.0.txt and MINICPM2-MODEL-CARD.md.

Retained model (Horizon)
  K2-Horizon-4B-Q4_K_M.gguf (3156598144 bytes)
  SHA256: 07773aed93890d4f5d08b421430000d5c8d73cefc74fbdc32e67d820f23207b2
  Published by IFM; derived from IFM/K2-Horizon-3.7B.
  https://huggingface.co/IFM/K2-Horizon-3.7B-GGUF
  Apache-2.0; see LICENSE-Apache-2.0.txt and HORIZON-MODEL-CARD.md.

K2-compatible runtime (llama-k2/)
  IFM llama.cpp fork commit 42adf019f76013dac873b5b43950d54d5ab27216,
  Windows x64 CPU AVX2 build. MIT; see llama-k2/LICENSE-llama.cpp.txt.
  https://github.com/MBZUAI-IFM/llama.cpp/tree/model/K2Horizon

Small fallback model
  Huihui-MiniCPM5-1B-abliterated.Q4_K_M.gguf (688067040 bytes)
  Quantized by mradermacher:
    https://huggingface.co/mradermacher/Huihui-MiniCPM5-1B-abliterated-GGUF
  Derived from huihui-ai/Huihui-MiniCPM5-1B-abliterated, base model openbmb/MiniCPM5-1B:
    https://huggingface.co/huihui-ai/Huihui-MiniCPM5-1B-abliterated
  License: Apache-2.0, as stated on the model card. See LICENSE-Apache-2.0.txt.

Runtime (llama/)
  llama.cpp b10964 CPU build: llama-server.exe and its libraries.
    https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/tree/b10964
  Copyright (c) 2023-2026 The ggml authors. MIT License. See llama/LICENSE-llama.cpp.txt.
  libomp.dll is the LLVM OpenMP runtime. See llama/LICENSE-LLVM-OpenMP.txt.

Retained model (Bonsai)
  Ternary-Bonsai-2-27B-Abliterated-PTQ1_0.gguf (5946648928 bytes)
  SHA256: 94dd53cbad55db5a515f245887c9f0317484502a451ccc0424c7d7788b52900a
  Published by BoldingBuilds; derived from prism-ml/Ternary-Bonsai-2-27B-gguf.
  https://huggingface.co/BoldingBuilds/Ternary-Bonsai-2-27B-Abliterated-PTQ1_0-GGUF
  Apache-2.0; see LICENSE-Apache-2.0.txt and BONSAI-MODEL-CARD.md.

Prism runtime (llama-prism/)
  PrismML llama.cpp prism-b10709-9a9394a, Windows x64 CUDA 12.4.
  https://github.com/PrismML-Eng/llama.cpp/releases/tag/prism-b10709-9a9394a
  MIT; see llama-prism/LICENSE-llama.cpp.txt.
  NVIDIA CUDA runtime, cuBLAS and cuBLASLt: see
  llama-prism/LICENSE-NVIDIA-CUDA-12.4.html for supplied license terms.

MiniCPM5-2B is preferred. MiniCPM5-1B remains the automatic CPU fallback;
Horizon and Bonsai can be selected explicitly.
